card.name: Single digits inside numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token such as 6, 1, 2, 7, 8 or 4 that sits in the middle of a number, often after a decimal point or in a table of weights and doses.

modes.label: Digit after decimal point
modes.description: A digit right after a period in a decimal value, as in lab or trial tables.
modes.example: .<<4>> Injection Site Reactions Including Necrosis Injection

modes.label: Digit in weight or dose table
modes.description: A digit starting or continuing a number in weight bands or dose schedules.
modes.example: Maintenance Dosage (mg/day) 11 to 21 kg 200 400 to 600 2<<2>> to 31 kg 30

modes.label: Digit in counts or times
modes.description: A digit within view counts or clock times in web text.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, mostly in dose and weight tables.
